data.title: 埃塔 · 雾化实验的成功瞬间
data.description: 实验室中央的容器中，薄雾沿着法阵旋转，又在晶体光芒里重新凝聚。埃塔难得睁大了眼睛，俯身观察，并飞快记下雾化实验的参数。
data.location: laboratory center with a glass vessel of swirling mist, a formation circle and monitoring crystals
data.action: observing mist inside a glass vessel with wide eyes, writing parameters on a notepad
data.promptProse: Alone in the laboratory, Eta watches mist gather inside a glass vessel above a glowing circle, writing the readings in her notebook.
